sentences.text: It is the case of the applicants that certain dispute has been initiated and culminated into institution of Case Crime No.37 of 2009, under Sections- 498A, 323, 504, 506 I.P.C. and Sections- 3/4 of D.P. Act, wherein all the six applicants were implicated.

4. The F.I.R. in Case Crime No.37 of 2009 has been put under challenge on behalf of the applicants/petitioners in Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No.10455 of 2009 for seeking quashing of the F.I.R., wherein at the time of admission stage, Division Bench of this Court sent the matter before Mediation and Conciliation Center, High Court Allahabd and during pendency of the investigation,
interim protection has been extended in favour of the applicants vide order dated 09.06.2009.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No.10455 of 2009
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: In pursuance to the above direction, mediation proceedings were successfully concluded on certain terms and conditions, which has been accepted by both the parties and specific report with regard to settlement agreement dated 13.08.2009 has been placed in the records of the Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No.10455 of 2009.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No.10455 of 2009
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: 5. All the terms and conditions has been complied by the applicants, specifically applicant no.1 and after observing the same learned Principal Judge, Family Court, Meerut dismissed the application under section 125 Cr.P.C. preferred on behalf of the opposite party no.2 by way of making endorsement that Rs.1,72,000/- mentioned in the mediation report, which has already been paid by the applicant no.1.

6. In the strict compliance of another terms and conditions, divorce (talaknama) have been reduced in writing on a notarized affidavit in the presence of two witnesses and the same also been finalized by way of execution of terms and conditions accepted between the parties before the mediation.

7. Learned counsel for the applicants submitted that on dated 03.08.2009 once the divorce has been taken place between the applicant no.1 and the opposite party no.2 and all the terms and conditions have been executed and the same was accepted, which was also mentioned in the same affidavit,
then there will be no persuasion on behalf of the opposite party no.2 in Case Crime No.37 of 2009.
8.

In spite of the abovementioned factual aspects, which has been came up in black and white before the Division Bench of this Court as well as before learned Principal Judge, Family Court, Meerut, on 25.11.2009 charge-sheet has been preferred against all the applicants under Sections- 498A, 323,
504, 506 I.P.C. and Sections- 3/4 of D.P. Act, which arises cause of action in favour of the applicants for preferring the instant application, wherein interim protection has been granted in favour of the applicants by way of observing facts and circumstances as mentioned above.

9. At the admission stage, notices were issued against the opposite party no.2 and the same has been reported that the notices were not returned, meaning thereby there is sufficient service upon opposite party no.2 and after lapse of near about 14 years, none has been appeared on behalf of the opposite party no.2 in any manner whatsoever.

Meaning thereby the terms and conditions mentioned in the mediation report has been accepted by the opposite party no.2 not to pursue in the matter before any court of law against the applicants and as such there is no option left but to proceed in the matter on the basis of pleadings and records preferred by the applicants themselves.

Mohd. Shahzad And Others vs State Of U.P.And Another on 10 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/82234190/
2 10.

entities.text: Mohd. Shahzad And Others vs State Of U.P.And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Per contra, learned A.G.A. although oppose the prayer but did not dispute the fact that mediation has already been solemnized and the same has been placed before the Hon'ble Division Bench of this Court and the same has been observed by co-ordinate Bench of this Court at the admission stage of instant application through which the interim protection has been granted in favour of the applicants.

11. After hearing rival submissions extended by learned counsel for the parties and after having the essence of the mediation report along with talaknama entered by both the parties i.e. applicant no.1 and opposite party no.2, which has been witnesses by family members from both the parties, there is hardly any dispute pending between the parties and the proper acceptance of the credible amount determined during the course of mediation has already been accepted by opposite party no.2.
12.
In view of the above, the charge-sheet preferred against the applicants is meaningless and as such is hereby quashed and set-aside.
13. The instant application is accordingly disposed of.
